Package hadur117.core.move

Class GunClassifier

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.move.GunClassifier
public final class GunClassifier extends Object
MOVE-15: tells whether the enemy's gun is a learning one, from the HF classes (HitForensics.classify(double, double, double)) of the bullets that hit us in the duel this battle. The count runs across the rounds of one battle and is cleared by reset() for the next.

Pure: no engine types, no clock, no randomness.
